scientific_integrity: Exact polynomial and Gaussian integer arithmetic with a standalone standard-library verifier; self-review only; no independent validation or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns this fixed integral coordinate model over Z[i] and the marked pair-intersection sections, not moduli-invariant reduction of any model.
At characteristic 2 and 5 the quartic is not smooth; reductions of the twelve labeled lines are not twelve distinct maximal tangency lines.
The distribution of primitive-section weights is not an intrinsic special-fiber singular scheme or flat limit of the generic 66-point reduced scheme.
The 1945 original by Edge was not inspected in full; an earlier unindexed equivalent arithmetic result remains possible.
title: Arithmetic specialization of twelve undulation tangents on the Komiya–Kuribayashi quartic
